title: The image of the critical set of a Lipschitz map ℝⁿ → ℝ^P is Hⁿ-null (Sard-type step of Simon Ch. 2, §3)
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), Hⁿ = μHE[n]), L ∈ ℝ≥0, and let f : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz. Let C be the set of w ∈ ℝⁿ at which f is differentiable and the derivative Df(w) = fderiv ℝ f w is not injective. Then Hⁿ(f(C)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (f : Eucl n → Eucl P) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (f '' {w | DifferentiableAt ℝ f w ∧ ¬ Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f w)}) = 0
